Merge AGENT_LOOP_TOOL_AGENT_ROLLOUT_CONFIG in the multimodal fixture, matching the basic tool-agent test. This ensures Ascend CI's deterministic settings reach both multimodal tests.

Preserve existing behavior when the environment variable is unset.

Related PR: #7518.

  - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test`
